snippet.title: Dung Ho! Official Trailer: OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
Dung Ho! is an up to 6 player co-op physics game where you and your friends embark on the treacherous journey rolling a (dung) ball across the wilds of Africa. Protect the ball. Bring it home. Your family gets fed. They’re proud of you. Probably.

Dung Ho! is OUT NOW on Steam! Play it today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4133210/Dung_Ho/

Join our Discord to keep up to date on Lesser Weevil and Dung Ho!: https://discord.com/invite/NAhbQzQ4s4
